_comment: GRAB driver sheet spec, built 2026-11-08 from the owners' base case file (research/GRAB/GRAB_Base_Case_and_Dashboard.md, Nov 7) and checked against Grab's 6-K releases. See research/GRAB/research_notes.md.
archetype: Southeast Asia superapp: mobility, deliveries, financial services
owner_note: Draft by agent 2026-11-08 from the owners' Nov 7 base case file; thresholds and D1's six signals accepted by the owners 2026-11-08; not yet imported

Drivers.name: Core: deliveries, mobility and ads
Drivers.thesis: Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines (about 62% of FY2025 revenue) fund the rest; if mobility take rates hold and the deliveries margin keeps rising, adjusted EBITDA compounds faster than revenue.
Drivers.notes: Owners' file: about 48% of the 2028 EBITDA lift (Deliveries ~22%, Mobility ~21%, Others ~5%). That is a share of EBITDA lift, not of today's price, so Share of price is left blank (decision 5). Capped by D3 if D3 turns red; translation drag from D6 (Indonesia about 21% of revenue). Six signals kept on purpose (owners 2026-11-08), one over the usual cap of 5; the app shows an 'over cap' tag on this driver.

Drivers.name: Financial Services
Drivers.thesis: Digital banks in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia (Superbank, consolidated from June 2026) and lending on Grab's transaction data; segment EBITDA turned positive in Q3 2026 and management targets $500M by 2028.
Drivers.notes: Owners' file: about 49% of the 2028 EBITDA lift. Share of price left blank (decision 5).

Drivers.name: Regulation and competition (take rates)
Drivers.thesis: Regulators in Indonesia and Vietnam are compressing mobility take rates, and robotaxis could bypass the marketplace later; a fee cap on cars or delivery in Indonesia is the main way core margins get cut.
Drivers.notes: Not separately valued (embedded in D1). A red D3 caps D1 at yellow in the owners' method; the app shows it as a dependency only.

Drivers.name: Balance sheet and capital return
Drivers.thesis: Net cash and buybacks give a partial floor; the Atome payment (about $1.49B at close) is the main call on cash.
Drivers.notes: Owners' file: net cash is about 25-36% of market cap; not used as Share of price.

Drivers.name: Atome and the 2028 bridge
Drivers.thesis: Atome is the largest single item in the 2028 Financial Services bridge and the least evidenced: five regulators must approve and close is due by Q3 2027.
Drivers.notes: Owners' file: about $130M of 2028 FS EBITDA [EST]; Foodpanda Taiwan removed from the bridge after the block. Evidence is thin: one company reiteration of the $1.7B target.

Drivers.name: Indonesia macro
Drivers.thesis: Indonesia is about 21% of FY2025 revenue and home to Superbank; macro stress is a currency-translation and credit-quality risk, not a 1997-style funding crisis (reserves cover short-term external debt about 1.8x).
Drivers.notes: Owners' scenarios (Oct 27 est.): grinding stabilization 55% (rupiah 17,500-18,500), stagnation 35%, crisis 10%. Detail lives in the owners' Indonesia Macro Watch dashboard.

Signals.name: Group adjusted EBITDA, $M per quarter
Signals.anchor: Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: the Q4 figure implied by the FY26 guide is $231-241M (about 2% either side of the midpoint); 5% allows for a single-source consensus.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Q3 2026 was helped by the consolidation of Superbank and Stash.

Signals.name: Group revenue, $M per quarter
Signals.anchor: Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: the Q4 range implied by the FY26 guide is $1,086-1,136M (about 2.3% either side of the midpoint).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them).

Signals.name: On-demand GMV growth, % YoY constant currency
Signals.anchor: Base 20% (owners' estimate). Red below 15%, the owners' thesis-break line (two straight quarters below about 15% CC). 15% used for now (owners 2026-11-08); the notes once said 12% (May 19). Duong to confirm.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). The gap between reported and constant-currency growth (4 points in Q3 2026) is the rupiah drag.

Signals.name: Mobility segment adjusted EBITDA margin, % of GMV
Signals.anchor: Base 8.5% (owners' estimate). Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: red below about 8.1%, under every quarter since Q2 2025 (8.56%-8.91%).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Computed as Mobility segment adjusted EBITDA divided by Mobility GMV (the release does not state it). Held through the Jul 1 2026 Indonesia two-wheel cap.

Signals.name: Mobility revenue growth, % YoY
Signals.anchor: Base 8% = the owners' alert line (owners 2026-11-08): green at or above 8%, red below it, no yellow band. The file had no base case; the line is a floor, not a forecast.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Reported (not constant-currency) growth. Slowed from 19% in Q1 2026; reasons named on the Q3 call: cheaper ride options, the Indonesia commission cap, higher incentives. The weakest part of the core.

Signals.name: Deliveries segment adjusted EBITDA margin, % of GMV
Signals.anchor: Base 4% is the owners' longer-run target, not a per-quarter path. Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: tolerance 35% (red below 2.6%) so the current climb shows yellow, as in the owners' file. A per-quarter path would be better.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Computed as Deliveries segment adjusted EBITDA divided by Deliveries GMV; the release rounds it to one decimal (2.3%, 2.3%, 2.7%). Advertising is the main lever.

Signals.name: Financial Services segment adjusted EBITDA, $M per quarter
Signals.anchor: Base -$10M (owners' green line: a loss no worse than $10M). Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: red when the loss is worse than $20M, i.e. widening past Q1 2026 (-$17M).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). First profit in Q3 2026, a quarter earlier than guided (breakeven was guided for H2 2026).

Signals.name: Group NPL ratio (90+ days past due), %
Signals.anchor: Base 4% = the owners' breach line, so green below it and red above it (no yellow band).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). First disclosed in Q3 2026. Group figure; Superbank is not broken out (see S13).

Signals.name: Gross loan portfolio, $B
Signals.definition_change: 2026-05-05: 'Loan portfolio' became 'Gross loan portfolio' (Q3 2025 restated from $821M to $903M). Series starts Q1 2026.
Signals.anchor: Base $2.6B for Q3 2026 and $3.0B for Q4 2026 (owners: on track for $3.0B at year end). Set by Claude, accepted by the owners 2026-11-08: tolerance 10%. Management targets more than $6B in 2028.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Customer deposits $2.7B at Q3 2026.

Signals.name: Loan-loss reserve cover, times NPLs
Signals.anchor: No base case (owners' file).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). First disclosed in Q3 2026 (ECL reserves 6.5% of the gross loan portfolio).

Signals.name: Superbank NPL ratio, %
Signals.anchor: No base case. Disclosure rule: grey for one cycle; if the Q4 print also withholds it, add a Withheld reading (red).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). Not broken out in Q3 2026 (first natural occasion after consolidation). See the Disclosure step.

Signals.name: Indonesia fee-cap scope
Signals.anchor: Owners' estimate (Oct 13): about 75% that the cap is not extended to cars or delivery over 18 months.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. 8% two-wheel commission cap: decree signed May 19 2026, live Jul 1 2026; mobility margin held. Q3 call: delivery/logistics guidelines on driver earnings and fee transparency under consideration. Management expects no material impact (a claim, not evidence); regulator text not retrieved. Two-wheelers are under 6% of mobility; Citi put the hit at about $35-40M EBITDA.

Signals.name: Grab share of Vietnam ride-hailing GMV, %
Signals.anchor: No base case (owners' file).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Conflict: Mordor says XanhSM leads on GMV (51.5%); Rakuten says Grab leads on usage. Vietnam is about 8% of revenue.

Signals.name: Vietnam competition-authority review
Signals.anchor: No base case. Owners' estimate (Oct 13): about 25% that a third market follows Indonesia and Vietnam.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Open since Sep 8 2026: documents requested on Grab's alleged 40-50% effective deductions.

Signals.name: Singapore robotaxi (Ai.R) commercial launch
Signals.anchor: No base case. No P&L effect expected before 2028.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Public rides since Apr 1 2026 (fleet 10, 50 planned). Waymo announced a Singapore entry with its own app for 2028 (Sep 17 2026): competition risk, narrative and multiple risk.

Signals.name: Net cash liquidity, $B
Signals.anchor: Base $2.0B = the owners' floor after the Atome payment; red below $1.0B, the owners' thesis-break line.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). About $3.5B after the Atome payment [derived: $5.0B - $1.49B]. Gross cash liquidity $7.1B at Sep 30 2026.

Signals.name: Share repurchases, $M per quarter (cash paid)
Signals.anchor: Base $150M per quarter (owners' estimate); red below $75M, the owners' red line.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them). From the cash flow statement. Sep-Oct 2026: $400M repurchased; $500M left, to be completed by Sep 2027.

Signals.name: Adjusted free cash flow, trailing 12 months, $M
Signals.definition_change: 2026-08-04: from Q2 2026, adjusted FCF excludes net changes in treasury liquidity positions in Financial Services.
Signals.anchor: No base case (management: 80% FCF conversion by 2028).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web (Grab files 6-K press releases without XBRL, so the SEC feeds cannot read them).

Signals.name: Insider open-market buying, $M
Signals.anchor: No base case (owners' file).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. [VERIFY] Owners' notes cite Form 4 filings, but Grab is a foreign private issuer whose insiders do not usually file Form 4; find the actual filing. No CFO or board buy; programmatic sales continue.

Signals.name: Atome regulatory approvals (five regulators) and close
Signals.anchor: Owners' estimate: first approval about Q1 2027; close due by Q3 2027.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Terms: 60% for $1.49B cash; the other 40% about two years later at 13x EBITDA, equity value floor $2.0B and cap $4.5B.

Signals.name: Group 2028 adjusted EBITDA target (company), $B
Signals.anchor: Base $1.5B = the owners' risk-adjusted 2028 estimate; red below $1.2B, the bear case in the owners' Sep 23 bridge.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. A company target, not a measured result: thin evidence. Owners' bridge: bear $1.2B, base $1.5B, bull $1.95B [EST]. Foodpanda Taiwan (about $25M in the bridge) is out after the block.

Signals.name: USD/IDR exchange rate, rupiah per dollar
Signals.anchor: Base 18,500 = top of the owners' 'grinding stabilization' range (17,500-18,500, Oct 27 est.); red past 19,000, the owners' breach line (a disorderly move).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web, refreshed biweekly. Bank Indonesia is intervening. About 8.7% weaker year to date.

Signals.name: Indonesia 10-year government bond yield, %
Signals.anchor: Base 7% = the owners' watch line; red above 8%, the owners' breach line (tolerance = 1/7).
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web, refreshed biweekly. Weak Oct 27 auction: Rp20.65T raised vs a Rp30T target.

Signals.name: Foreign portfolio outflows (equities, bonds, SRBI)
Signals.anchor: Owners' breach rule: bond outflows join equity outflows.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Oct 19-22 2026: -$1.0B (Rp18.2T) across equities, bonds and SRBI. Equities -Rp94.9T year to date.

Signals.name: MSCI market-status review for Indonesia
Signals.anchor: Owners' breach rule: reclassification confirmed.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. Consultation opened Oct 15 2026; FTSE kept Indonesia a secondary emerging market (Oct 26). Goldman estimates about $5.6B of passive outflows (plus $2.7B for FTSE) on a downgrade.

Signals.name: Indonesia sovereign rating and outlook
Signals.anchor: Owners' breach rule: any downgrade toward BBB-.
Signals.notes: Feed: agent: web. BBB / Baa2; Moody's and Fitch on negative outlook. Fitch warned on Oct 21 that the MSCI risk could pressure ratings.
